description: Framework skills. An agent reads this index, picks the skill whose `activity` matches the task (and whose tags match the app's stack), and loads that SKILL.md. Plain self-contained markdown — no host, no injection required.

skills.name: creator
skills.description: Build a new Agent App from a requirements spec: scaffold, build feature by feature under the ownership boundary, gate, launch, walk-verify.

skills.name: modify
skills.description: Evolve an existing Agent App because requirements changed, safely: decide data-vs-code, edit under the ownership boundary, dev → gate → walk-verify → promote with a pre-promote backup.

skills.name: importer
skills.description: Bring an app in, or send one out: install a marketplace app (catalogue, confirm, install; no walk-verify), install an Agent App package from a zip, folder or git repository (inspect first, walk-verify after), convert a Living UI app or foreign code by rebuilding it, adopt a foreign app as it is behind the sidecar adapter, export an app to share.

skills.name: operator
skills.description: Operate and diagnose a running Agent App on the user's behalf via A2App — read state, write through the guard, invoke declared operations, and take work the app queues for you. No code changes.

skills.name: walk-verify
skills.description: Independently verify a running Agent App against reference/requirements.md AND the Agent App Quality Standard (QUALITY.md, beside this index) by driving the real UI, feature by feature. Run by an agent that is NOT the builder. Verdicts: pass | defects | incomplete | blocked.

skills.name: connect
skills.description: Connect to a published Agent App you do not own: select it by URL, verify its identity, get a credential the person you act for approves (`a2app <app> login`), check the grant, then operate it exactly as any local app. Operate only, never modify.
